title: Technique 4 (Most Important): The Near-Repeat Pattern
simple_summary: If house #12 is burglarized on Monday, the burglar now knows the layout, escape paths, and lack of alarms in that street. For the next 2-4 weeks, the SAME house (Repeat) and its immediate neighbours within 200m (Near-Repeat) face sharply higher risk.
key_concept: Spatio-Temporal Contagion: Like an infectious disease or ripples in a pond, criminal risk radiates outwards immediately after an incident and decays after 28 days.
recommended_action: Within 48 hours of any burglary, dispatch beat officers to knock on the 10 closest neighboring doors, advise on window latches, and conduct short drive-bys for 14 days.
non_tech_takeaway: Near-repeat is the single most reliable, well-evidenced pattern in international criminology. It requires no complex math—just your own FIR dates and door numbers.
